 * The other difference is that _route_ path is stripped and not visible

build_meta.query:
You are investigating how a matched Express Route propagates an error through its own middleware stack, in lib/router/route.js. Starting from `dispatch`, trace the exact causal pipeline that runs when one of the route's own handlers calls `next(err)` with a real error: which internal function actually decides whether to invoke a layer's 4-arity error handler versus its ordinary request handler, and what real symbol that decision calls into.

First give a short (2-4 sentence) explanation of the pipeline.

Then, on its own line, emit a fenced JSON code block containing an ordered array of the fully-qualified symbol names in that causal order - only symbols actually present in the provided context package may appear, e.g.:

```json
["lib.router.route.dispatch", "lib.router.route.next"]
```
